profile.about: Semester 5 student in Computerized Accounting at Politeknik Negeri Semarang with a strong foundation in financial reporting, expense verification, and data reconciliation. Skilled in Microsoft Excel, ERP systems, and basic programming to support accurate and efficient financial data processing. Detail-oriented, organized, and capable of handling multiple tasks while ensuring data consistency and timely reporting. Interested in contributing to organizations focused on sustainability and social impact.
